result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by requiring HDI to defend and indemnify the Company and its affiliates against third-party claims involving IP infringement, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused data incidents, and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. It also includes notice, defence control, cooperation, and settlement protections. No customer indemnity is added, so there is no overbroad customer indemnity to correct. The addition is targeted and preserves the existing Globix provision. Drafting is professional, though it could be improved with clause numbering and customary qualifications concerning prejudice from delayed notice and consent to settlement not being unreasonably withheld.
